in_hebrew.name: Kaylyn
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Pure, Slender, Cleansing
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Kaylyn הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Kalliope' meaning 'beautiful voice' and the Hebrew name 'Kelilah' meaning 'slender or little one'. In Christian tradition, Kaylyn is believed to represent the pure and cleansing qualities of the Virgin Mary.
